calls.title: Carrefour + GrowthBook
calls.summary: Participants discussed the advantages of GrowthBook's enterprise license for Carrefour, emphasizing its advanced governance and security features tailored for large organizations. The conversation highlighted the role-based access control, self-hosting options for security-focused clients, and the ability to control feature rollouts safely through targeted feature flagging. Christian introduced the new AI-powered visual editor that simplifies experiment creation for non-technical users, while the warehouse-native architecture ensures precise internal data integration and privacy. The team's strategy includes building a business case comparing GrowthBook with AB Tasty, citing large existing clients to strengthen GrowthBook's credibility. Plans were made for follow-up discussions focusing on specific use cases to gain buy-in from Carrefour's leadership.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Carrefour, Enterprise License, Feature Flagging, Experimentation, A/B Testing
